✨ Smile Makeover · Ahmedabad

Complete Smile Makeover Guide

Veneers, whitening, bonding and aligners — how to combine treatments for your dream smile, and what it costs in Ahmedabad.

Dr. Siddharth Mehta
BDS MDS · Implant & Laser Dentist, Ahmedabad
📍 Shyamal Cross Road, Ahmedabad🕐 5 min read🦷 Expert Dental Article

What Is a Smile Makeover?

Smile makeover results — Dr. Siddharth's Dental Care, Ahmedabad

A smile makeover isn't one single treatment — it's a combination of cosmetic procedures planned together to transform your entire smile, not just fix one tooth.

Common combinations we use in Ahmedabad

  • Whitening + Veneers: Brighten first, then place veneers matched to the new shade
  • Bonding + Contouring: Reshape chipped or uneven teeth without veneers
  • Aligners + Whitening: Straighten first, then whiten for the final reveal
  • Gum Contouring + Veneers: For a 'gummy smile,' reshape the gumline before veneers

The smile design process

  • Step 1: Consultation — discuss what you don't like about your current smile
  • Step 2: Digital smile preview — see a mockup before committing
  • Step 3: Treatment sequencing — whitening/ortho first, restorative work last
  • Step 4: Execution over multiple visits depending on complexity
Digital smile design consultation — our Ahmedabad clinic

Cost ranges in Ahmedabad

✨ Whitening only: ₹8,000–₹15,000
💎 Veneers (per tooth): ₹8,000–₹20,000
📐 Clear aligners: ₹60,000–₹1,50,000
🎨 Full smile makeover (combination): ₹80,000–₹2,00,000+ depending on scope

How long does it take?

Simple makeovers (whitening + bonding) can be done in 1–2 visits. Complex makeovers involving aligners typically take 6–18 months before the final cosmetic work begins.
